description: Measures tickets against the ones your team already shipped: sections, length, labels, duplicates.
name: io.github.syrian963/ticket-ai-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Which tracker to read: gitlab, jira or github.
environmentVariables.name: TICKET_AI_TRACKER

environmentVariables.description: The project to measure. A GitLab path like acme/shop or its numeric id, a Jira project key like PROJ, or a GitHub owner/repo.
environmentVariables.name: TICKET_AI_PROJECT

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the GitLab instance, for example https://gitlab.example.com. Required when the tracker is gitlab.
environmentVariables.name: TICKET_AI_GITLAB_URL

environmentVariables.description: GitLab personal access token. The read_api scope is enough; nothing here writes.
environmentVariables.name: TICKET_AI_GITLAB_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Jira instance. Cloud or self-hosted Server and Data Center; which one is detected from the instance.
environmentVariables.name: TICKET_AI_JIRA_URL

environmentVariables.description: Account email, for Jira Cloud's basic auth. Leave unset for a public board or for a Server personal access token.
environmentVariables.name: TICKET_AI_JIRA_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Jira API token from id.atlassian.com, or a Server personal access token on its own. Leave unset to read a public instance anonymously.
environmentVariables.name: TICKET_AI_JIRA_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: GitHub token with read access to the repository's issues.
environmentVariables.name: TICKET_AI_GITHUB_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Checkout to search when gathering context for a subject. Defaults to the working directory, which on a wrong guess produces confident nonsense - the report names the directory it searched.
environmentVariables.name: TICKET_AI_REPO

environmentVariables.description: Force the language tickets should be written in, overriding what was measured in the corpus. Leave unset unless the board is mid-switch: a measurement beats a setting.
environmentVariables.name: TICKET_AI_TICKET_LANGUAGE

environmentVariables.description: Where the learned profile is kept between runs. Defaults to .ticket-ai/ under the working directory.
environmentVariables.name: TICKET_AI_CACHE_DIR

title: Ticket AI
